title: DFS Launches 'Bharat Maritime Insurance Pool (BMIP)' Offering .5 Billion War-Risk P&I Insurance
summary: India's 1st sovereign-backed Protection & Indemnity insurance pool reduces war-risk premium rates by 35-40%.

blocks.title: 📰 3. 🏦 BANKING & INSURANCE NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 DFS Launches 'Bharat Maritime Insurance Pool (BMIP)' Offering .5 Billion War-Risk P&I Insurance. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: India's 1st sovereign-backed Protection & Indemnity insurance pool reduces war-risk premium rates by 35-40%.
Underwriting Capacity: Indemnity limit up to .5 billion provided under sovereign backing.
1st Policy Recipient: DFS handed over 1st P&I policy under BMIP to Shipping Corporation of India (SCI).
Product Designer: Designed by The New India Assurance Company Ltd.
BMIP indemnity limit (.5 billion) vs premium rate reduction (35–40%).
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on institutional financial products, interest margins, capital adequacy ratios, and digital payment infrastructure.
